info.title: School master data WP-03
info.description: HttpOnly cookie authentication. Writes require exact Origin and X-CSRF-Token; errors 400/401/403/404/409/503. GET pagination page>=1, page_size<=100; filters search (100 chars), academic_year_id, class_id, status. Teacher reads current assigned classes only. effective_at defaults server now; no future student transfers.
